requirement: Apply writes a WordPress site's own mailboxes: option tracy_contact_to (where the theme's contact form sends) and contact.email of tracy_site_identity (the address its theme shows)

oracle.ref: PR #926 (fix); fix evidence: Ledger L17b of the Apply audit, 05/10/2026: the Tracy WordPress themes send their own contact form to option tracy_contact_to and nowhere else (never admin_email); the Build path wrote it (apply-wordpress.mjs), Apply did not, so a visitor's message through the theme's own form failed, and the kinetic theme 1.1.6 shows contact.email of tracy_site_identity, which Apply never set.
oracle.invariant: S2: pass 4, fail 0: with a mailbox typed the sweep sets option tracy_contact_to to it and contact.email of tracy_site_identity to it; with none typed, the recipient is the account that pressed Apply (never written into the identity option) and a demo address the site showed is emptied; an option already right is not written again; an identity stored nested or as flat dotted keys keeps its shape; an option that cannot be read is said in the notes and not overwritten; a sweep given no recipient and no contact writes no option. Before the fix: 3 of the 4 fail. S3: fail 0: the engine's other behaviour (form recipients, links, pages) is unchanged. S4: at least 1: the sweep writes options through content.update. Every command exits 0.
